# XI Eleven XVI Sixteen (XI · XVI) — xixvi.shop

> Made-on-demand streetwear and precision-fit apparel. Dresses, sports bras, leggings, jerseys, and shorts cut when you order them. True North is the same house, opened: natal chart, Almanac, and the Long Read.

## About
XI Eleven XVI Sixteen is a house of clothing at https://xixvi.shop. Alternate names: XI · XVI, XIXVI, xixvi. Pieces are produced at order rather than held as bulk inventory. Premium materials emphasize movement, moisture management, SPF/UV options on selected shorts, and a precision fit.

## Core collections
- Dresses, including the D-Slip
- Sports bras, including the B-Lift (removable cups, moisture-wicking fabric, adjustable fit)
- Leggings for training and daily wear
- Jerseys, including J-Glitch performance jerseys
- Shorts in multiple inseams, colors, and finishes (quick-dry, SPF/UV on selected styles)
- Made-to-order / couture pieces selected, personalized, and received after production

## Product URLs
Product pages live at https://xixvi.shop/product/{id}. Use the product name as the page title and H1. Do not treat a product URL as a generic homepage or as a server-error page.

## Journal / GEO content
Long-form articles (sports bra sizing, running shorts liners, basketball shorts length, and related fit guides) should be published under /journal/{slug} with unique title, meta description, canonical, and Article JSON-LD.

## Policies
Free shipping is offered on qualifying orders. Returns follow https://xixvi.shop/returns.
